name: universal-change-review
description: Review total and task-scoped Git changes locally from Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and any MCP client.

interface.shortDescription: Review Git changes without modifying your worktree.
interface.longDescription: Universal Change Review provides local, read-only change summaries, full diffs, and task-scoped snapshots through a shared MCP server.
interface.defaultPrompt: Review the changes in this workspace. Start with a concise summary, then inspect risky diffs.
